title: Rivals Clash in the First 'Roça' of A Fazenda 18
seoTitle: A Fazenda 18: First Roça Puts Four at Risk
subtitle: What happened during the vote that put four contestants at risk of elimination
excerpt: On Tuesday night (22), the first 'roça' of A Fazenda 18 determined who stays in the house and who ends up on the chopping block.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: R7, Notícias da TV, Extra online
contentHtml:
The first 'roça' of A Fazenda 18 was marked by a tense vote that put four contestants at risk of elimination. The dynamic, which took place on Tuesday night (22), featured 26 participants who, after a week of broken alliances, had to decide who would remain in the house and who would go to the chopping block.

how the voting began

Before the farmer's nomination, Thaíde opened the Lamp of Power and chose the scroll with the Yellow Flame Power. The Red Flame Power, chosen by the public, was given to rapper Mayk Leão, who received a quadruple-weight vote. The influencer surprised the deck by voting for Giovanna, leaving the vote tied.

decision of farmer Fran Almeida

Fran nominated Stephanie Gomes straight to the first stool, citing that the contestant "added nothing" to the house. The voting among the contestants resulted in 9 votes for Darlin and 5 for Giovanna, but Mayk's vote kept the tie. The tiebreaker was decided by Fran, who sent Giovanna to the chopping block. Serginho Hondjakoff was chosen by Darlin and sent to the third stool.

resta-um and the 48-hour challenge without hot water

To determine the last spot in the 'roça', the contestants started the traditional Resta Um. Mayk had to choose between saving Thaíde or Darlin and ended up sending his rival to the last stool. Before the end of the voting session, Thaíde opened the yellow scroll, revealing that the house would go 48 hours without hot water, but he would pocket R$ 5,000 if he accepted the challenge. The rapper took the money, and the house was punished.

farmer's challenge and the farmer's hat

Darlin Ferrattry won the Farmer's Challenge on Wednesday (23) and won the farmer's hat. The victory guaranteed her escape from the 'roça' and allowed her to nominate a rival for the next chopping block. The challenge involved transporting milk to a giant bottle, and Darlin came out on top.

what is at stake for the remaining contestants

With the 'roça' formed, only Darlin, Stephanie, and Serginho will remain in the race for the farmer's hat. Giovanna was banned from the challenge by Darlin herself, preventing her from escaping the 'roça'. The voting on Notícias da TV allows fans to choose who should continue in the competition. The dynamic continues in the upcoming challenges, where the contestants will make their pleas to stay in the game.

With information from R7, Notícias da TV, Extra online.
